# A64 FP and AdvSIMD load and store cases for tests/a64_simd.rs, generated by running each
# instruction word natively on an Apple M4. V0 to V3 start as the four values of SIMD_MEM_V, X1 points
# at a buffer whose byte at X1 + k is k mod 256 for k from -128 to 383, and X2 is the given offset.
#
# Fields, all hex unless noted: insn x2 => v0 v1 v2 v3 writeback offset:changed doubleword ... ; asm
# The writeback is the decimal change of X1 and each changed doubleword is its decimal offset from
# the original X1 and its new value.
